product.desc:
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION

Width of belt is 32mm

These webbing belts are made with fabric and leather.

They are woven and stretchable waist belt, thus providing ULTIMATE COMFORT.

Soft elastic fabric interwoven to stretch and to allow air cooling.

Fashionable and cool, suitable for both men and women.

The buckle connector and tip and made of REAL LEATHER, thus far more durable than similar type available in market.

The BUCKLE QUALITY is superior.

Elegant BOX PACKING, suitable for gifts.

DIMENSIONS

S Size - Suitable for waist size - 24 inches to 26 inches

M Size - Suitable for waist size - 28 inches to 34 inches

L Size - Suitable for waist size - 36 inches to 38 inches

XL Size - Suitable for waist size - 40 inches to 46 inches

\Please refer the BELT SIZE GUIDE in the pics

MATERIAL

Made of Premium quality leather and fabric .

Durable Metal buckle.

LOCAL BRAND

Over 100,000 products have been sold in Singapore

EXCHANGE

Oxhide offers hassle-free exchanges, use the Chat Now option in order details of Lazada to initiate the exchange OR CALL US on +65 90601324.

WARRANTY

Backed by Oxhide's brand promise to provide premium quality products at reasonable prices.

The product is covered by 6 month's warranty

Scratches, stains, etc are not covered under warranty.

Visit the store for any warranty claims. Proof of purchase is mandatory for any warranty claims.

Leather is developed from natural resources, each hide of leather has its unique characteristics and can never be uniform.

Slight blemishes indicate originality and should not be considered defects.
